algo.description: Hashing algorithm used for OTP secrets (e.g., sha1, sha256, sha512). Must match oathtool compatibility.

period.description: Time period in seconds for the OTP generation cycle.

digits.description: Number of digits in the generated OTP code.

clip.description: Enable clipboard copying for otp code and otp uri commands by default.

default_issuer.description: Default issuer label used in the otpauth URI if not explicitly provided.

clip_time.description: Number of seconds to wait before restoring the clipboard buffer after a clip operation.
